title: Report of one run, as H0 accepts it from the exercise channel (H-1)
description: annatar/runner/report.py writes it; the campaign report reads its run id and its attack time. Other fields are allowed. Its run_id must also be the run's own (checked by analysis/campaign_schema.py, which runs on H0). A run --without-glorfindel (V1) says so in without_glorfindel, and then carries no detection verdict.
